policies.sentence: Students must understand every line of the code they submit, including AI-generated code.
Students must be able to explain and defend all code they submit, in their own words.
Students must not submit or copy code they do not understand or cannot explain.
Students are accountable for the AI content they submit.
Instructors may require students to explain code orally, in a code review or at a meeting.
Students who cannot explain their submitted code face penalties, a lower grade or an integrity charge.
Course staff will not help students who do not understand their own code.
Students must comment their code to show they understand it and what it does.
Being able to walk someone through your project shows you understand it and own it.
